listing.name: Lightning Dog's Super Conversion Hullmods
listing.summary: Are you tired of ships not being playerbait? Are you exhausted at seeing things "finely balanced" to the point they're boring? Would you, maybe, just maybe, like to give that Onslaught (XIV) Manjets on top of it's burn drive? NOW YOU CAN!
listing.aiSummary: Adds four powerful hullmods that convert colony items and ship OP into massive stat boosts.

description: Includes flux jet overhauls for small and large ships, an extreme armor and shield shunt system, and an electronic warfare network that sacrifices an Alpha Core. These mods are designed to make ships significantly stronger by consuming resources and operational points.
